azkar.text: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
azkar.commentary:
[ar]أوصى النبي ﷺ ابنته فاطمة رضي الله عنها أن تقوله إذا أصبحت وإذا أمست.
[en]The Prophet ﷺ advised his daughter Fatimah to say it every morning and evening.
[tr]Peygamber ﷺ kızı Fâtıma'ya (r.anhâ) bunu sabah ve akşam söylemesini tavsiye etti.
azkar.translationEn: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I call for help: set right all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
azkar.translationTr: Ey Hayy, ey Kayyûm! Rahmetinle yardım dilerim. Bütün işlerimi düzelt ve beni göz açıp kapayıncaya kadar bile nefsime bırakma.
azkar.transliterationEn: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi-rahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullah, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.

azkar.text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
azkar.translationEn: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its openings, its victory, its light, its blessing and its guidance; and I seek refuge in You from the evil in it and the evil of what comes after it.
azkar.translationTr: Sabaha erdik, mülk de âlemlerin Rabbi Allah'ın olarak sabaha erdi. Allah'ım! Senden bu günün hayrını; fethini, zaferini, nurunu, bereketini ve hidayetini isterim. Bu günün ve sonrasının şerrinden sana sığınırım.
azkar.transliterationEn: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-'alamin. Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhal-yawm: fathahu, wa nasrahu, wa nurahu, wa barakatahu, wa hudah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fihi wa sharri ma ba'dah.

azkar.text: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
azkar.translationEn: We have entered the morning upon the natural way of Islam, upon the word of pure devotion, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, who was upright and submitted to Allah, and was not of those who associate partners with Him.
azkar.translationTr: İslam fıtratı üzere, ihlas kelimesi üzere, Peygamberimiz Muhammed'in ﷺ dini üzere ve Allah'ı birleyen, O'na teslim olan ve müşriklerden olmayan atamız İbrahim'in milleti üzere sabaha erdik.
azkar.transliterationEn: Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini nabiyyina Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, wa 'ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
azkar.commentary:
[ar]«من قال حين يصبح وحين يمسي: سبحان الله وبحمده، مائة مرة، لم يأت أحد يوم القيامة بأفضل مما جاء به، إلا أحد قال مثل ما قال أو زاد عليه».
[en]“Whoever says it one hundred times in the morning and in the evening, no one will bring anything better on the Day of Resurrection, except someone who said the same or more.”
[tr]“Kim sabah ve akşam yüz kez söylerse, kıyamet günü hiç kimse onun getirdiğinden daha üstününü getiremez; ancak onun gibi veya daha fazla söyleyen müstesna.”
azkar.translationEn: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him.
azkar.translationTr: Allah'ı hamd ile tesbih ederim.
azkar.transliterationEn: SubhanAllahi wa bi-hamdih.

azkar.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
azkar.reward:
[ar]النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة (٢٤)، البخاري (٣٢٩٣)، مسلم (٢٦٩١)
[en]An-Nasa'i, 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah 24; Al-Bukhari 3293; Muslim 2691
[tr]Nesâî, Amelü'l-yevm ve'l-leyle 24; Buhârî 3293; Müslim 2691
azkar.commentary:
[ar]تقال عشر مرات إذا أصبح، أو مرة واحدة عند الكسل. ومن قالها مائة مرة في يوم «كانت له عدل عشر رقاب، وكُتبت له مائة حسنة، ومُحيت عنه مائة سيئة، وكانت له حرزًا من الشيطان يومه ذلك حتى يمسي، ولم يأت أحد بأفضل مما جاء به إلا أحد عمل أكثر من ذلك».
[en]Said ten times in the morning, or once when tired. Whoever says it one hundred times in a day “will have the reward of freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds will be written for him and a hundred sins erased, and it will be a protection for him from Satan that day until evening; and no one will bring anything better except one who did more.”
[tr]Sabah on kez, yorgunken bir kez söylenir. Kim bunu bir günde yüz kez söylerse “on köle azat etmiş gibi sevap alır, ona yüz iyilik yazılır, yüz günahı silinir ve o gün akşama kadar şeytandan korunur. Ondan fazlasını yapan dışında hiç kimse onun getirdiğinden daha üstününü getiremez.”
azkar.translationEn: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.
azkar.translationTr: Allah'tan başka ilah yoktur; O tektir, ortağı yoktur. Mülk O'nundur, hamd O'nadır ve O her şeye kadirdir.
azkar.transliterationEn: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
azkar.commentary:
[ar]قالها النبي ﷺ لجويرية رضي الله عنها وقد جلست تذكر الله من الفجر إلى الضحى: «لقد قلتُ بعدكِ أربع كلمات ثلاث مرات، لو وُزنت بما قلتِ منذ اليوم لوزنتهن».
[en]The Prophet ﷺ said to Juwayriyah, who had sat remembering Allah from Fajr until mid-morning: “After I left you I said four phrases three times; if they were weighed against all you have said today, they would outweigh it.”
[tr]Peygamber ﷺ, sabah namazından kuşluk vaktine kadar zikirle oturan Cüveyriye'ye (r.anhâ): “Senden sonra üç kez dört söz söyledim; bugün söylediklerinle tartılsa onlara ağır basardı” buyurdu.
azkar.translationEn: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, as many times as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as much as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words.
azkar.translationTr: Allah'ı; yarattıklarının sayısınca, kendi rızası kadar, arşının ağırlığınca ve kelimelerinin mürekkebi miktarınca hamd ile tesbih ederim.
azkar.transliterationEn: SubhanAllahi wa bi-hamdihi 'adada khalqih, wa rida nafsih, wa zinata 'arshih, wa midada kalimatih.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
azkar.reward:
[ar]ابن ماجه (٩٢٥)، ابن السني (٥٤)
[en]Ibn Majah 925, Ibn as-Sunni 54
[tr]İbn Mâce 925, İbnü's-Sünnî 54
azkar.commentary:
[ar]كان النبي ﷺ يقوله إذا صلى الصبح حين يسلّم.
[en]The Prophet ﷺ used to say it after the Fajr prayer, as soon as he had finished with the salam.
[tr]Peygamber ﷺ bunu sabah namazında selam verince söylerdi.
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that benefits, provision that is good and pure, and deeds that are accepted.
azkar.translationTr: Allah'ım! Senden faydalı ilim, helal ve temiz rızık ve kabul edilmiş amel isterim.
azkar.transliterationEn: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala.

azkar.text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
azkar.commentary:
[ar]قال النبي ﷺ: «يا أيها الناس توبوا إلى الله، فإني أتوب في اليوم إليه مائة مرة».
[en]The Prophet ﷺ said: “O people, turn to Allah in repentance, for I turn to Him in repentance a hundred times a day.”
[tr]Peygamber ﷺ: “Ey insanlar! Allah'a tövbe edin; ben günde yüz kez O'na tövbe ederim” buyurdu.
azkar.translationEn: I seek Allah's forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.
azkar.translationTr: Allah'tan bağışlanma diler, O'na tövbe ederim.
azkar.transliterationEn: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
azkar.commentary:
[ar]«من صلى عليّ حين يصبح عشرًا، وحين يمسي عشرًا، أدركته شفاعتي يوم القيامة».
[en]“Whoever sends prayers upon me ten times in the morning and ten times in the evening will receive my intercession on the Day of Resurrection.”
[tr]“Kim sabah on, akşam on kez bana salavat getirirse kıyamet günü şefaatime nail olur.”
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, send Your prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
azkar.translationTr: Allah'ım! Peygamberimiz Muhammed'e salât ve selâm eyle.
azkar.transliterationEn: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad.

azkar.text: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ١ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ٢ لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ ٣ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ ٤
azkar.commentary:
[ar]كان النبي ﷺ إذا أوى إلى فراشه كل ليلة جمع كفيه ثم نفث فيهما فقرأ فيهما الإخلاص والفلق والناس، ثم يمسح بهما ما استطاع من جسده، يبدأ بهما على رأسه ووجهه وما أقبل من جسده، يفعل ذلك ثلاث مرات. (البخاري ٥٠١٧، مسلم ٢١٩٢)
[en]Every night when the Prophet ﷺ went to bed he would put his palms together, blow into them and recite al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and an-Nas, then wipe as much of his body as he could, beginning with his head, his face and the front of his body. He did this three times. (Al-Bukhari 5017, Muslim 2192)
[tr]Peygamber ﷺ her gece yatağına girince avuçlarını birleştirir, içlerine üfler ve İhlâs, Felak ve Nâs surelerini okurdu. Sonra başından, yüzünden ve vücudunun ön tarafından başlayarak elinin yettiği yerleri meshederdi. Bunu üç kez yapardı. (Buhârî 5017, Müslim 2192)
azkar.translationEn: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor was He begotten, and there is none comparable to Him.
azkar.translationTr: De ki: O Allah birdir. Allah Samed'dir; her şey O'na muhtaçtır. O doğurmamış ve doğmamıştır. Hiçbir şey O'na denk değildir.
azkar.transliterationEn: Qul Huwallahu Ahad. Allahus-Samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad.

azkar.text: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ ١ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ٢ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ٣ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ ٤ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ٥
azkar.translationEn: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
azkar.translationTr: De ki: Sabahın Rabbine sığınırım; yarattığı şeylerin şerrinden, çöktüğü zaman karanlığın şerrinden, düğümlere üfleyenlerin şerrinden ve haset ettiği zaman hasetçinin şerrinden.
azkar.transliterationEn: Qul a'udhu bi-Rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.

azkar.text: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ١ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ٢ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ٣ مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ ٤ ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ٥ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ٦
azkar.translationEn: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers into the hearts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.
azkar.translationTr: De ki: İnsanların Rabbine, insanların Melik'ine, insanların İlahına sığınırım; sinsi vesvesecinin şerrinden. O ki insanların göğüslerine vesvese verir; cinlerden de insanlardan da.
azkar.transliterationEn: Qul a'udhu bi-Rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.

azkar.text: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ ٱلۡقَيُّومُۚ لَا تَأۡخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٞ وَلَا نَوۡمٞۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَشۡفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيۡءٖ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَۚ وَسِعَ كُرۡسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفۡظُهُمَاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ ٢٥٥
azkar.commentary:
[ar]«إذا أويت إلى فراشك فاقرأ آية الكرسي... فإنه لن يزال عليك من الله حافظ، ولا يقربك شيطان حتى تصبح». (البخاري ٢٣١١)
[en]“When you go to bed, recite Ayat al-Kursi… a guardian from Allah will remain with you, and no devil will come near you until morning.” (Al-Bukhari 2311)
[tr]“Yatağına girdiğinde Âyetü'l-Kürsî'yi oku… Allah katından bir koruyucu seninle olur ve sabaha kadar sana hiçbir şeytan yaklaşmaz.” (Buhârî 2311)
azkar.translationEn: Allah: there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all that exists. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who could intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they grasp nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and guarding them does not weary Him. He is the Most High, the Most Great.
azkar.translationTr: Allah, O'ndan başka ilah yoktur; O diridir, her şeyi ayakta tutandır. O'nu ne uyuklama ne de uyku tutar. Göklerde ve yerde ne varsa O'nundur. İzni olmadan O'nun katında kim şefaat edebilir? O, kulların önlerindekini ve arkalarındakini bilir. Onlar O'nun ilminden, dilediği kadarı dışında hiçbir şeyi kavrayamazlar. O'nun kürsüsü gökleri ve yeri kaplamıştır; onları koruyup gözetmek O'na ağır gelmez. O çok yücedir, çok büyüktür.
azkar.transliterationEn: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bi-shay'im-min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim.

azkar.text: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيۡنَ أَحَدٖ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦۚ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۖ غُفۡرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ ٢٨٥ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا مَا ٱكۡتَسَبَتۡۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوۡ أَخۡطَأۡنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡنَآ إِصۡرٗا كَمَا حَمَلۡتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦۖ وَٱعۡفُ عَنَّا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَآۚ أَنتَ مَوۡلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٢٨٦
azkar.commentary:
[ar]«من قرأ بالآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه». (البخاري ٥٠٠٩، مسلم ٨٠٧)
[en]“Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.” (Al-Bukhari 5009, Muslim 807)
[tr]“Kim geceleyin Bakara suresinin son iki âyetini okursa, bu ona yeter.” (Buhârî 5009, Müslim 807)
azkar.translationEn: The Messenger believes in what has been sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Each of them believes in Allah, His angels, His Books and His messengers: “We make no distinction between any of His messengers.” And they say: “We hear and we obey. Grant us Your forgiveness, our Lord; to You is the final return.” Allah does not burden any soul beyond its capacity. It gains whatever good it has earned and bears whatever evil it has done. “Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not lay upon us a burden like the one You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.”
azkar.translationTr: Peygamber, Rabbinden kendisine indirilene iman etti, müminler de. Hepsi Allah'a, meleklerine, kitaplarına ve peygamberlerine iman etti. “O'nun peygamberlerinden hiçbiri arasında ayrım yapmayız” dediler ve “İşittik, itaat ettik. Rabbimiz! Bağışlamanı dileriz; dönüş sanadır” dediler. Allah hiçbir kimseye gücünün yeteceğinden fazlasını yüklemez. Herkesin kazandığı iyilik kendi lehine, yaptığı kötülük de kendi aleyhinedir. “Rabbimiz! Unutur ya da yanılırsak bizi sorumlu tutma. Rabbimiz! Bizden öncekilere yüklediğin gibi bize de ağır yük yükleme. Rabbimiz! Bize gücümüzün yetmeyeceği şeyleri yükleme. Bizi affet, bizi bağışla, bize merhamet et. Sen bizim Mevlâmızsın; kâfirler topluluğuna karşı bize yardım et.”
azkar.transliterationEn: Amanar-Rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir-Rabbihi wal-mu'minun, kullun amana billahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih, la nufarriqu bayna ahadim-mir-rusulih, wa qalu sami'na wa ata'na, ghufranaka Rabbana wa ilaykal-masir. La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa 'alayha maktasabat, Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na, Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alal-ladhina min qablina, Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih, wa'fu 'anna, waghfir lana, warhamna, Anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.

azkar.text: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
azkar.translationEn: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it up. If You take my soul, have mercy on it, and if You send it back, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
azkar.translationTr: Rabbim! Senin adınla yanımı yere koydum, seninle kaldırırım. Ruhumu alırsan ona merhamet et; geri gönderirsen, salih kullarını koruduğun şeyle onu da koru.
azkar.transliterationEn: Bismika Rabbi wada'tu janbi, wa bika arfa'uh, fa-in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi 'ibadakas-salihin.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْيَاهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, You created my soul and You take it back. Its death and its life belong to You. If You keep it alive, protect it, and if You cause it to die, forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being.
azkar.translationTr: Allah'ım! Nefsimi sen yarattın, onu sen vefat ettireceksin. Ölümü de hayatı da sana aittir. Onu yaşatırsan koru, öldürürsen bağışla. Allah'ım! Senden afiyet isterim.
azkar.transliterationEn: Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsi wa Anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wa mahyaha, in ahyaytaha fahfazha, wa in amattaha faghfir laha. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afiyah.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (٥٠٤٥)، الترمذي (٣٣٩٨)
[en]Abu Dawud 5045, At-Tirmidhi 3398
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 5045, Tirmizî 3398
azkar.commentary:
[ar]كان النبي ﷺ إذا أراد أن يرقد وضع يده اليمنى تحت خده ثم قالها ثلاث مرات.
[en]When the Prophet ﷺ wanted to sleep, he placed his right hand under his cheek and said this three times.
[tr]Peygamber ﷺ uyumak istediğinde sağ elini yanağının altına koyar, sonra bunu üç kez söylerdi.
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
azkar.translationTr: Allah'ım! Kullarını dirilttiğin gün beni azabından koru.
azkar.transliterationEn: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.

azkar.text: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
azkar.translationEn: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
azkar.translationTr: Allah'ım! Senin adınla ölür, senin adınla dirilirim.
azkar.transliterationEn: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ، وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the earth and Lord of the Mighty Throne, our Lord and the Lord of all things, who splits the grain and the date-stone, who sent down the Torah, the Gospel and the Criterion: I seek refuge in You from the evil of every creature whose forelock You hold. O Allah, You are the First and there is nothing before You; You are the Last and there is nothing after You; You are the Most High and there is nothing above You; You are the Most Near and there is nothing closer than You. Settle our debts for us and free us from poverty.
azkar.translationTr: Allah'ım! Ey yedi göğün Rabbi, yerin Rabbi ve büyük arşın Rabbi! Rabbimiz ve her şeyin Rabbi! Tohumu ve çekirdeği yaran, Tevrat'ı, İncil'i ve Furkân'ı indiren Allah'ım! Perçeminden tuttuğun her şeyin şerrinden sana sığınırım. Allah'ım! Sen Evvel'sin, senden önce hiçbir şey yoktur; sen Âhir'sin, senden sonra hiçbir şey yoktur; sen Zâhir'sin, senin üstünde hiçbir şey yoktur; sen Bâtın'sın, senden daha yakın hiçbir şey yoktur. Borcumuzu öde ve bizi fakirlikten kurtarıp zengin kıl.
azkar.transliterationEn: Allahumma Rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa Rabbal-ardi wa Rabbal-'arshil-'azim, Rabbana wa Rabba kulli shay', faliqal-habbi wan-nawa, wa munzilat-Tawrati wal-Injili wal-Furqan, a'udhu bika min sharri kulli shay'in Anta akhidhun bi-nasiyatih. Allahumma Antal-Awwalu fa-laysa qablaka shay', wa Antal-Akhiru fa-laysa ba'daka shay', wa Antaz-Zahiru fa-laysa fawqaka shay', wa Antal-Batinu fa-laysa dunaka shay', iqdi 'annad-dayna wa aghnina minal-faqr.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
azkar.commentary:
[ar]قال النبي ﷺ لعلي وفاطمة رضي الله عنهما لما سألاه خادمًا: «ألا أدلكما على ما هو خير لكما من خادم؟ إذا أويتما إلى فراشكما فسبّحا ثلاثًا وثلاثين، واحمدا ثلاثًا وثلاثين، وكبّرا أربعًا وثلاثين، فهو خير لكما من خادم». (البخاري ٣٧٠٥، مسلم ٢٧٢٧)
[en]When 'Ali and Fatimah asked the Prophet ﷺ for a servant, he said: “Shall I not tell you of something better for you than a servant? When you go to bed, say SubhanAllah thirty-three times, Al-hamdu lillah thirty-three times and Allahu akbar thirty-four times. That is better for you than a servant.” (Al-Bukhari 3705, Muslim 2727)
[tr]Ali ve Fâtıma (r.anhümâ) bir hizmetçi istediklerinde Peygamber ﷺ şöyle buyurdu: “Size hizmetçiden daha hayırlısını söyleyeyim mi? Yatağınıza girdiğinizde otuz üç kez Sübhânallah, otuz üç kez Elhamdülillah ve otuz dört kez Allâhu ekber deyin. Bu sizin için bir hizmetçiden daha hayırlıdır.” (Buhârî 3705, Müslim 2727)
azkar.translationEn: Glory be to Allah.
azkar.translationTr: Allah'ı tesbih ederim.
azkar.transliterationEn: SubhanAllah.

azkar.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
azkar.translationEn: All praise is for Allah.
azkar.translationTr: Hamd Allah'a mahsustur.
azkar.transliterationEn: Al-hamdu lillah.

azkar.text: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
azkar.translationEn: Allah is the Greatest.
azkar.translationTr: Allah en büyüktür.
azkar.transliterationEn: Allahu akbar.

azkar.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْوِيَ
azkar.translationEn: All praise is for Allah, who fed us and gave us drink, who sufficed us and gave us shelter; for how many are there who have no one to suffice them and no one to shelter them.
azkar.translationTr: Bizi doyuran, içiren, bize yeten ve bizi barındıran Allah'a hamdolsun. Nice kimseler var ki onlara yetecek ve onları barındıracak kimse yoktur.
azkar.transliterationEn: Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana, wa kafana wa awana, fa-kam mimman la kafiya lahu wa la mu'wi.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
azkar.reward:
[ar]الترمذي (٣٣٩٢)، أبو داود (٥٠٦٧)
[en]At-Tirmidhi 3392, Abu Dawud 5067
[tr]Tirmizî 3392, Ebû Dâvûd 5067
azkar.commentary:
[ar]قال النبي ﷺ لأبي بكر رضي الله عنه: «قلها إذا أصبحت، وإذا أمسيت، وإذا أخذت مضجعك».
[en]The Prophet ﷺ told Abu Bakr: “Say it in the morning, in the evening, and when you lie down to sleep.”
[tr]Peygamber ﷺ Ebû Bekir'e (r.a.): “Bunu sabah, akşam ve yatağına yattığında söyle” buyurdu.
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things: I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul, from the evil of Satan and his call to associate partners with You, and from doing wrong to myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
azkar.translationTr: Ey gizliyi ve açığı bilen, gökleri ve yeri yaratan, her şeyin Rabbi ve sahibi olan Allah'ım! Senden başka ilah olmadığına şahitlik ederim. Nefsimin şerrinden, şeytanın şerrinden ve şirke çağırmasından, kendime bir kötülük yapmaktan veya onu bir Müslümana bulaştırmaktan sana sığınırım.
azkar.transliterationEn: Allahumma 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, Rabba kulli shay'in wa malikah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa Ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.

azkar.text: يَقْرَأُ (الم تَنْزِيلُ) السَّجْدَةَ، و(تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ)
azkar.commentary:
[ar]كان النبي ﷺ لا ينام حتى يقرأ «الم تنزيل» السجدة و«تبارك الذي بيده الملك».
[en]The Prophet ﷺ would not sleep until he had recited Alif Lam Mim Tanzil (as-Sajdah) and Tabarak alladhi biyadihil-mulk (al-Mulk).
[tr]Peygamber ﷺ Secde ve Mülk surelerini okumadan uyumazdı.
azkar.translationEn: Recite Surah As-Sajdah (Alif Lam Mim Tanzil) and Surah Al-Mulk (Tabarak alladhi biyadihil-mulk).
azkar.translationTr: Secde Suresi (Elif Lâm Mîm Tenzîl) ve Mülk Suresi (Tebârekellezî biyedihi'l-mülk) okunur.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَى مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
azkar.commentary:
[ar]«إذا أتيت مضجعك فتوضأ وضوءك للصلاة، ثم اضطجع على شقك الأيمن، ثم قل:... فإن متّ من ليلتك فأنت على الفطرة، واجعلهن آخر ما تتكلم به».
[en]“When you go to bed, perform ablution as you would for prayer, lie on your right side and say this… If you die that night, you die upon the fitrah. Make these the last words you speak.”
[tr]“Yatağına gireceğin zaman namaz abdesti gibi abdest al, sonra sağ tarafına yat ve bunu söyle… O gece ölürsen fıtrat üzere ölürsün. Bunları söylediğin son sözler yap.”
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, I submit myself to You, I entrust my affairs to You, I turn my face to You and I rest my back upon You, in hope of You and in awe of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You sent down and in Your Prophet whom You sent.
azkar.translationTr: Allah'ım! Kendimi sana teslim ettim, işimi sana bıraktım, yüzümü sana çevirdim, sırtımı sana dayadım; sana rağbet ederek ve senden korkarak. Senden kaçıp sığınacak yer yine ancak sensin. İndirdiğin kitaba ve gönderdiğin peygambere iman ettim.
azkar.transliterationEn: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa alja'tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bi-kitabikal-ladhi anzalt, wa bi-nabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt.

azkar.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
azkar.translationEn: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, The One, AL-Qahhar. Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all between them, The Exalted in Might, The Oft-Forgiving.

title: دعاء القلق والفزع في النوم ومن بُلي بالوحشة

azkar.text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
azkar.translationEn: I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the madness and appearance of devils.

title: ما يفعل من رأى الرؤيا أو الحلم

azkar.text: يَنْفُثُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ
azkar.translationEn: Spit lightly to your left (three times).

azkar.text: يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَى
azkar.translationEn: Seek refuge in Allah from the devil and from the evil of what you saw (three times).

azkar.text: لَا يُحَدِّثُ بِهَا أَحَدًا
azkar.translationEn: Do not tell anyone about it.

azkar.text: يَتَحَوَّلُ عَنْ جَنْبِهِ الَّذِي كَانَ عَلَيْهِ
azkar.translationEn: Turn over from the side you were sleeping on.

azkar.text: يَقُومُ يُصَلِّي إِنْ أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ
azkar.translationEn: Get up and pray, if you wish.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، وَلَا يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ، تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided, pardon me along with those whom You have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom You are an ally to and bless for me that which You have bestowed. Protect me from the evil You have decreed for verily You decree and none can decree over You. For surety, he whom you show allegiance to is never abased and he whom You take as an enemy is never honoured and mighty. O our Lord, Blessed and Exalted are You.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (١٤٢٧)، الترمذي (٣٥٦٦)، وصححه الألباني
[en]Abu Dawud 1427, At-Tirmidhi 3566 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 1427, Tirmizî 3566 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise. You are as You have praised Yourself.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ، وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالْكَافِرِينَ مُلْحِقٌ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعِينُكَ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ، وَلَا نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفُرُكَ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, it is You we worship, and unto You we pray and prostrate, and towards You we hasten and You we serve. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment, verily Your punishment will fall upon the disbelievers. O Allah, we seek Your aid and ask Your pardon, we praise You with all good and do not disbelieve in You. We believe in You and submit unto You, and we disown and reject those who disbelieve in You.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ رَبِّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
azkar.translationEn: Glory be to the King, the Most Holy, Lord of the angels and of the Spirit (Jibril). (Raise your voice the third time.)

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجِلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
azkar.commentary:
[ar]دعاء الهم والحزن تفريج للكربات وجلاء للأحزان بأن يجعل الله القرآن العظيم ربيع القلوب ونور الصدور وذهاب الهموم.
[en]Supplication for anxiety and sadness turns feelings of depression into divine solace, inner light, and peace through the Holy Quran.
[tr]Keder ve üzüntü anında yapılan bu dua, Kur'an'ı kalbin baharı ve sıkıntıların ilacı kılarak derin bir huzur bahşeder.
[ur]غم اور پریشانی کی یہ دعا قرآن کو دل کی بہار بنا کر دلی سکون اور خوشی عطا فرماتی ہے۔
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, my forelock is in Your hand (i.e. You have total mastery over), Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
azkar.commentary:
[ar]دعاء الهم والحزن تفريج للكربات وجلاء للأحزان بأن يجعل الله القرآن العظيم ربيع القلوب ونور الصدور وذهاب الهموم.
[en]Supplication for anxiety and sadness turns feelings of depression into divine solace, inner light, and peace through the Holy Quran.
[tr]Keder ve üzüntü anında yapılan bu dua, Kur'an'ı kalbin baharı ve sıkıntıların ilacı kılarak derin bir huzur bahşeder.
[ur]غم اور پریشانی کی یہ دعا قرآن کو دل کی بہار بنا کر دلی سکون اور خوشی عطا فرماتی ہے۔
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.

azkar.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
azkar.commentary:
[ar]دعاء الكرب يلهج بتوحيد الله العظيم الحليم رب العرش العظيم، فتنكشف به الغمة وتتيسر به العسرة.
[en]The prayer in distress invokes Allah's supreme greatness and mercy, bringing immediate comfort to broken spirits in severe trials.
[tr]Sıkıntı ve zorluk anında okunan bu tesirli dua, arşın Rabbi olan Allah'ın yüceliğine sığınarak ferahlık bulmayı sağlar.
[ur]سخت پریشانی کے وقت کی دعا جو اللہ کی عظمت اور حلم کے واسطے سے ہر مشکل کو آسان کر دیتی ہے۔
azkar.translationEn: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the noble throne.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
azkar.commentary:
[ar]دعاء الكرب يلهج بتوحيد الله العظيم الحليم رب العرش العظيم، فتنكشف به الغمة وتتيسر به العسرة.
[en]The prayer in distress invokes Allah's supreme greatness and mercy, bringing immediate comfort to broken spirits in severe trials.
[tr]Sıkıntı ve zorluk anında okunan bu tesirli dua, arşın Rabbi olan Allah'ın yüceliğine sığınarak ferahlık bulmayı sağlar.
[ur]سخت پریشانی کے وقت کی دعا جو اللہ کی عظمت اور حلم کے واسطے سے ہر مشکل کو آسان کر دیتی ہے۔
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs. None has the right to be worshipped except You.

azkar.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
azkar.reward:
[ar]الترمذي (٣٥٠٥)، وصححه الألباني
[en]At-Tirmidhi 3505 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Tirmizî 3505 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.commentary:
[ar]دعاء الكرب يلهج بتوحيد الله العظيم الحليم رب العرش العظيم، فتنكشف به الغمة وتتيسر به العسرة.
[en]The prayer in distress invokes Allah's supreme greatness and mercy, bringing immediate comfort to broken spirits in severe trials.
[tr]Sıkıntı ve zorluk anında okunan bu tesirli dua, arşın Rabbi olan Allah'ın yüceliğine sığınarak ferahlık bulmayı sağlar.
[ur]سخت پریشانی کے وقت کی دعا جو اللہ کی عظمت اور حلم کے واسطے سے ہر مشکل کو آسان کر دیتی ہے۔
azkar.translationEn: None has the right to be worshipped except You. How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.

azkar.text: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
azkar.commentary:
[ar]دعاء الكرب يلهج بتوحيد الله العظيم الحليم رب العرش العظيم، فتنكشف به الغمة وتتيسر به العسرة.
[en]The prayer in distress invokes Allah's supreme greatness and mercy, bringing immediate comfort to broken spirits in severe trials.
[tr]Sıkıntı ve zorluk anında okunan bu tesirli dua, arşın Rabbi olan Allah'ın yüceliğine sığınarak ferahlık bulmayı sağlar.
[ur]سخت پریشانی کے وقت کی دعا جو اللہ کی عظمت اور حلم کے واسطے سے ہر مشکل کو آسان کر دیتی ہے۔
azkar.translationEn: Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (١٥٣٧)، وصححه الألباني
[en]Abu Dawud 1537 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 1537 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ، وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper, by You I move and by You I attack and by You I battle.

azkar.text: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
azkar.translationEn: Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee (He is).

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَارًا مِنْ فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍ وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلَائِقِكَ أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against (such and such a person) and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.

azkar.text: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعًا، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعَ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلَانٍ وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَارًا مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
azkar.translationEn: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what I fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. (I seek refuge in You Allah) from the evil of Your slave (name of the person), and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الْأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.

title: دعاء من أصابه شك في الإيمان

azkar.text: يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ. يَنْتَهِي عَمَّا وَسْوَسَ فِيهِ
azkar.translationEn: Seek refuge in Allah, and stop dwelling on the doubt.

azkar.text: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
azkar.translationEn: I believe in Allah and His messengers.

azkar.text: هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّـٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ ٣
azkar.translationEn: He is the First and the Last, the Most High and the Most Near, and He knows all things. (Al-Hadid 57:3)

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
azkar.reward:
[ar]الترمذي (٣٥٦٣)، وحسّنه الألباني
[en]At-Tirmidhi 3563 (graded hasan by al-Albani)
[tr]Tirmizî 3563 (Elbânî: hasen)
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.

azkar.text: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَاتْفِلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ
azkar.translationEn: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil. (Then spit lightly to your left three times.)

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.

title: ما يقول ويفعل من أذنب ذنبًا

azkar.text: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذْنِبُ ذَنْبًا فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلَّا غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (١٥٢١)، وصححه الألباني
[en]Abu Dawud 1521 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 1521 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: Any servant who commits a sin and as a result, performs ablution, prays two units of prayer (i.e. two rak'ahs) and then seeks Allah's forgiveness, Allah would forgive him.

azkar.text: الِاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُ
azkar.translationEn: Seeking refuge in Allah from him.

azkar.text: الْأَذَانُ
azkar.translationEn: The Adhaan (call to prayer).

azkar.text: الْأَذْكَارُ وَقِرَاءَةُ الْقُرْآنِ
azkar.translationEn: Recitation of the Quran and the authentic texts of remembrance and supplications.

title: الدعاء حينما يقع ما لا يرضاه أو غلب على أمره

azkar.text: قَدَّرَ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
azkar.translationEn: Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.

azkar.text: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ . وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ الْمُهَنَّأُ فَيَقُولُ: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ
azkar.translationEn: May Allah bless you with His gift to you and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness. The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly.

azkar.text: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُعَوِّذُ الْحَسَنَ وَالْحُسَيْنَ: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَكُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
azkar.translationEn: Ibn Abbas related that the Messenger of Allah used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah's protection, saying:(I commend you two to the protection of Allah's perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.).

azkar.text: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
azkar.translationEn: Never mind, may it (the sickness) be a purification, if Allah wills.

azkar.text: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (٣١٠٦)، الترمذي (٢٠٨٣)، وصححه الألباني
[en]Abu Dawud 3106, At-Tirmidhi 2083 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 3106, Tirmizî 2083 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: I ask Allah the Almighty, Lord of the mighty Throne, to heal you.

azkar.text: قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ مَشَى فِي خِرَافَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ، فَإِذَا جَلَسَ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ غُدْوَةً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مَسَاءً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ
azkar.translationEn: Ali Ibn Abee Talib related that he heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'If a man calls on his sick Muslim brother, it is as if he walks reaping the fruits of Paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is showered in mercy, and if this was in the morning, seventy thousand angels send prayers upon him until the evening, and if this was in the evening, seventy thousand angels send prayers upon him until the morning.

title: دعاء المريض الذي يئس من حياته

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions.

azkar.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
azkar.translationEn: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

azkar.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
azkar.translationEn: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and there is no might and no power except with Allah.

azkar.text: مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلَامِهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (٣١١٦)، وصححه الألباني
[en]Abu Dawud 3116 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 3116 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: Whoever's last words are “None has the right to be worshipped except Allah” will enter Paradise. (Those with a dying person gently remind him to say it.)

azkar.text: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ اؤْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
azkar.translationEn: To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return. O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلَانٍ (بِاسْمِهِ) وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, forgive -here the name of the deceased is mentioned- and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him O Lord of the worlds. Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا، اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
azkar.reward:
[ar]ابن ماجه (١٤٩٨)، وصححه الألباني
[en]Ibn Majah 1498 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]İbn Mâce 1498 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ (فُلَانَ بْنَ فُلَانٍ) فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
azkar.reward:
[ar]ابن ماجه (١٤٩٩)، وصححه الألباني
[en]Ibn Majah 1499 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]İbn Mâce 1499 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire. Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ احْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِن كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، اللَّهُمْ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطًا وَذُخْرًا لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعًا مُجَابًا، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجُورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلَافِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, protect him from the torment of the grave. O Allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. O Allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good) and magnify their reward. Make him join the righteous of the believers. Place him in the care of Ibrahim. Save him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell. Give him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those who have gone (i.e. passed away) before us, our children lost (by death), and those who have preceded us in Faith.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطًا، وَسَلَفًا، وَأَجْرًا
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, make him for us a precursor,a forerunner and a cause of reward.

azkar.text: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
azkar.translationEn: To Allah belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed time. So be patient and hope for His reward.

azkar.text: أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ
azkar.translationEn: May Allah make your reward great, give you comfort in your loss, and forgive your dead.

azkar.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
azkar.translationEn: In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him.

azkar.text: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ، أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
azkar.translationEn: Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we will, Allah willing, be united with you. May Allah have mercy on those of us who have gone before and those who come later. We ask Allah for well-being for us and you.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, I ask You for its goodness and I take refuge with You from its evil.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, I ask You for its goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from its evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
azkar.translationEn: How perfect He is, (The One) Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angels out of fear of Him.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا، مَرِيئًا مَرِيعًا، نَافِعًا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلًا غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (١١٦٩)، وصححه الألباني
[en]Abu Dawud 1169 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 1169 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِ بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (١١٧٦)، وحسّنه الألباني
[en]Abu Dawud 1176 (graded hasan by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 1176 (Elbânî: hasen)
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.

azkar.text: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
azkar.translationEn: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلَا عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الْآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, (let it fall) on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees.

azkar.text: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
azkar.translationEn: Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.

azkar.text: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (٢٣٥٧)، وحسّنه الألباني
[en]Abu Dawud 2357 (graded hasan by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 2357 (Elbânî: hasen)
azkar.translationEn: The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me.

azkar.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
azkar.translationEn: In the name of Allah. (If you forget at the start, say: In the name of Allah, at its beginning and its end.)

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ، وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ، وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَنًا فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
azkar.reward:
[ar]الترمذي (٣٤٥٥)، وحسّنه الألباني
[en]At-Tirmidhi 3455 (graded hasan by al-Albani)
[tr]Tirmizî 3455 (Elbânî: hasen)
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, bless it for us and feed us with something better than it. (When given milk to drink: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.)

azkar.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
azkar.reward:
[ar]الترمذي (٣٤٥٨)، ابن ماجه (٣٢٨٥)، وحسّنه الألباني
[en]At-Tirmidhi 3458, Ibn Majah 3285 (graded hasan by al-Albani)
[tr]Tirmizî 3458, İbn Mâce 3285 (Elbânî: hasen)
azkar.translationEn: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.

azkar.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
azkar.translationEn: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.

title: الدعاء لمن سقاه أو إذا أراد ذلك

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.

title: دعاء إذا أفطر عند أهل بيت

azkar.text: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (٣٨٥٤)، ابن ماجه (١٧٤٧)، وصححه الألباني
[en]Abu Dawud 3854, Ibn Majah 1747 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 3854, İbn Mâce 1747 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angels send prayers upon you.

title: دعاء الصائم إذا حضر الطعام ولم يفطر

azkar.text: إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ؛ فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِمًا فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِرًا فَلْيَطْعَمْ. وَمَعْنَى فَلْيُصَلِّ، أَيْ: فَلْيَدْعُ
azkar.translationEn: When one of you is invited, let him accept. If he is fasting, let him pray for his host; if he is not fasting, let him eat.

title: ما يقول الصائم إذا سابَّه أحد

azkar.text: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
azkar.translationEn: I am fasting, I am fasting.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us, bless our sa' for us and bless our mudd for us.

azkar.text: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلِ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ. فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
azkar.translationEn: When one of you sneezes he should say:(All praise is for Allah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (May Allah have mercy upon you.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.).

title: ما يقالُ للكافر إذا عطس فحمد الله

azkar.text: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
azkar.translationEn: May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.

azkar.text: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (٢١٣٠)، الترمذي (١٠٩١)، وصححه الألباني
[en]Abu Dawud 2130, At-Tirmidhi 1091 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 2130, Tirmizî 1091 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: May Allah bless for you (your spouse) and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
azkar.reward:
[ar]ابن ماجه (٢٢٥٢)، وحسّنه الألباني
[en]Ibn Majah 2252 (graded hasan by al-Albani)
[tr]İbn Mâce 2252 (Elbânî: hasen)
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, I ask You for her good and the good of the nature You created her with, and I seek refuge in You from her evil and the evil of the nature You created her with.

azkar.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
azkar.translationEn: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.

azkar.text: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
azkar.translationEn: I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.

azkar.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
azkar.reward:
[ar]الترمذي (٣٤٣١)، ابن ماجه (٣٨٩٢)، وحسّنه الألباني
[en]At-Tirmidhi 3431, Ibn Majah 3892 (graded hasan by al-Albani)
[tr]Tirmizî 3431, İbn Mâce 3892 (Elbânî: hasen)
azkar.translationEn: All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.

azkar.text: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الْغَفُورُ
azkar.reward:
[ar]الترمذي (٣٤٣٤)، وصححه الألباني
[en]At-Tirmidhi 3434 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Tirmizî 3434 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance, for You are the Accepter of repentance, the Forgiving.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (٤٨٥٩)، الترمذي (٣٤٣٣)، وقال الألباني: حسن صحيح
[en]Abu Dawud 4859, At-Tirmidhi 3433 (graded hasan sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 4859, Tirmizî 3433 (Elbânî: hasen sahih)
azkar.translationEn: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. I bear witness that None has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.

title: الدعاء لمن قال: غفر الله لك

azkar.text: وَلَكَ
azkar.translationEn: And you too. (The reply to someone who says to you: “May Allah forgive you.”)

azkar.text: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
azkar.translationEn: May Allah reward you with goodness.

title: ما يعصم الله به من الدجال

azkar.text: ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ عِوَجَاۜ ١ قَيِّمٗا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأۡسٗا شَدِيدٗا مِّن لَّدُنۡهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرًا حَسَنٗا ٢ مَّـٰكِثِينَ فِيهِ أَبَدٗا ٣ وَيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدٗا ٤ مَّا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٖ وَلَا لِأٓبَآئِهِمۡۚ كَبُرَتۡ كَلِمَةٗ تَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡۚ إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كَذِبٗا ٥ فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٞ نَّفۡسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمۡ إِن لَّمۡ يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا ٦ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ زِينَةٗ لَّهَا لِنَبۡلُوَهُمۡ أَيُّهُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗا ٧ وَإِنَّا لَجَٰعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيۡهَا صَعِيدٗا جُرُزًا ٨ أَمۡ حَسِبۡتَ أَنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡكَهۡفِ وَٱلرَّقِيمِ كَانُواْ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا عَجَبًا ٩ إِذۡ أَوَى ٱلۡفِتۡيَةُ إِلَى ٱلۡكَهۡفِ فَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةٗ وَهَيِّئۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَمۡرِنَا رَشَدٗا ١٠
azkar.translationEn: The first ten verses of Surat al-Kahf (18:1-10). Whoever memorises them will be protected from the Dajjal.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hell, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah (the Dajjal).

title: الدعاء لمن قال: إني أحبك في الله

azkar.text: أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ
azkar.translationEn: May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.

azkar.text: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
azkar.translationEn: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.

azkar.text: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالْأَدَاءُ
azkar.reward:
[ar]النسائي (٤٦٨٣)، وصححه الألباني
[en]An-Nasa'i 4683 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Nesâî 4683 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating anything with You, and I ask Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.

title: الدعاء لمن قال بارك الله فيك

azkar.text: وَفِيكَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ
azkar.translationEn: And may Allah bless you too.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ لَا طَيْرَ إِلَّا طَيْرُكَ، وَلَا خَيْرَ إِلَّا خَيْرُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, there is no omen except what comes from You, no good except Your good, and none has the right to be worshipped except You.

azkar.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
azkar.translationEn: In the name of Allah. All praise is for Allah.

azkar.text: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقۡرِنِينَ ١٣ وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ ١٤
azkar.translationEn: Glory be to Him who has placed this at our service, for we could not have done it ourselves; and to our Lord we will surely return. (Az-Zukhruf 43:13-14)

azkar.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، إِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
azkar.translationEn: All praise is for Allah (three times). Allah is the Greatest (three times). Glory be to You, O Allah; I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

azkar.text: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
azkar.translationEn: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest.

azkar.text: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقۡرِنِينَ ١٣ وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ ١٤
azkar.translationEn: Glory be to Him who has placed this at our service, for we could not have done it ourselves; and to our Lord we will surely return. (Az-Zukhruf 43:13-14)

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا، وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance for us. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who takes care of the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from a sorrowful sight, and from an evil return to my wealth and family.

azkar.text: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
azkar.translationEn: We return, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this village, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I take refuge with You from the evil of this village, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it.

azkar.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
azkar.reward:
[ar]الترمذي (٣٤٢٨)، وحسّنه الألباني
[en]At-Tirmidhi 3428 (graded hasan by al-Albani)
[tr]Tirmizî 3428 (Elbânî: hasen)
azkar.translationEn: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things, omnipotent.

azkar.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
azkar.translationEn: In the name of Allah.

azkar.text: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
azkar.translationEn: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.

azkar.text: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (٢٦٠٠)، الترمذي (٣٤٤٣)، وصححه الألباني
[en]Abu Dawud 2600, At-Tirmidhi 3443 (graded sahih by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 2600, Tirmizî 3443 (Elbânî: sahih)
azkar.translationEn: I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.

azkar.text: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ مَا كُنْتَ
azkar.translationEn: May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.

azkar.text: قَالَ جَابِرٌ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: كُنَّا إِذَا صَعِدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سَبَّحْنَا
azkar.translationEn: Jabir said: Whenever we went up a hill we would say Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) and when we descended we would say Subhanallah (Glory is to Allah).

azkar.text: سَمِعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ وَحُسْنِ بَلَائِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
azkar.translationEn: May a witness, be witness to our praise of Allah for His favours and bounties upon us. Our Lord, protect us, show favour on us and deliver us from every evil. I take refuge in Allah from the fire.

title: الدعاء إذا نزل منزلًا في سفر أو غيره

azkar.text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
azkar.translationEn: I take refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil that He has created.

azkar.text: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
azkar.translationEn: Allah is the Greatest (three times). None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is able to do all things.

azkar.text: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
azkar.translationEn: We return, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, helped His servant, and alone defeated the confederates.

title: ما يقول ويفعل من أتاه أمر يسره أو يكرهه

azkar.text: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ ، وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
azkar.translationEn: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet used to say:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)). Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected. And if something happened that displeased him, he used to say:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)). Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.

title: فضل الصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

azkar.text: قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلَاةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْرًا
azkar.translationEn: The Prophet (PBUH) said: 'Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.

azkar.text: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: لَا تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيدًا، وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلَاتَكُمْ تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ
azkar.translationEn: He (PBUH) also said: 'Do not take my grave as a place of habitual ceremony. Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are.

azkar.text: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ
azkar.translationEn: He (PBUH) also said: 'A miser is one whom when I am mentioned to him, fails to send prayers upon me.

azkar.text: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلَائِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلَامَ
azkar.translationEn: The Prophet (PBUH) said:'Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings (or prayers of peace) of my 'Ummah (nation).

azkar.text: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلَّا رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامَ
azkar.translationEn: The Prophet (PBUH) said: 'No one sends greetings (or prayers of peace) upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings.

azkar.text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: لَا تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلَا أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُمْ؟ أَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ بَيْنَكُمْ
azkar.translationEn: The Messenger of Allah said: 'You shall not enter paradise until you believe, and you shall not believe until you love one another. Shall I not inform you of something, if you were to act upon it, you will indeed achieve mutual love for one another? Spread the greeting amongst yourselves.

azkar.text: ثَلَاثٌ مَنْ جَمَعَهُنَّ فَقَدْ جَمَعَ الْإِيمَانَ: الْإِنْصَافُ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ، وَبَذْلُ السَّلَامِ لِلْعَالَمِ، وَالْإِنْفَاقُ مِنَ الْإِقْتَارِ
azkar.translationEn: Ammar said: 'Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend (charitably) out of the little you have.

azkar.text: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: أَيُّ الْإِسْلَامِ خَيْرٌ؟ قَالَ: تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرَأُ السَّلَامَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ
azkar.translationEn: Abdullah ibn Amr reported that a man asked the Prophet : 'Which Islam is the best?'. He replied: Feed (the poor), and greet those whom you know as well as those whom you do not.

title: كيف يرد السلام على الكافر إذا سلم

azkar.text: إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: وَعَلَيْكُمْ
azkar.translationEn: When the people of the Book greet you, reply by saying: (And upon you.).

azkar.text: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكًا، وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَانًا
azkar.translationEn: If you hear the crow of a rooster, ask Allah for his bounty for it has seen an angel and if you hear the braying of an ass, seek refuge in Allah for it has seen a devil.

azkar.text: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
azkar.translationEn: I seek refuge in Allah the Almighty from the accursed devil.

azkar.text: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, to any believer whom I have insulted, let that be cause to draw him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.

title: ما يقول المسلم إذا مدح المسلم

azkar.text: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ مَادِحًا صَاحِبَهُ لَا مَحَالَةَ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسِبُ فُلَانًا، وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلَا أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَدًا، أَحْسِبُهُ – إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ – كَذَا وَكَذَا
azkar.translationEn: If one of you must praise his companion, let him say: I think so-and-so is such-and-such, and Allah is his Reckoner, and I do not vouch for anyone before Allah; I think him to be such-and-such, if he knows that of him.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْرًا مِمَّا يَظُنُّونَ
azkar.translationEn: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of (and make me better than they imagine).

title: كيف يلبي المحرم في الحج أو العمرة

azkar.text: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
azkar.translationEn: Here I am O Allah, (in response to Your call), here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.

azkar.text: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
azkar.translationEn: Allah is the Greatest.

title: الدعاء بين الركن اليماني والحجر الأسود

azkar.text: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٗ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حَسَنَةٗ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٢٠١
azkar.reward:
[ar]أبو داود (١٨٩٢)، وحسّنه الألباني
[en]Abu Dawud 1892 (graded hasan by al-Albani)
[tr]Ebû Dâvûd 1892 (Elbânî: hasen)
azkar.translationEn: The Prophet PBUH used to say between the Yemeni corner and the black stone: "O our Lord, grant us the best in this life and the best in the next life, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire."

azkar.text: لَمَّا دَنَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنَ الصَّفَا قَرَأَ: ﴿إِنَّ ٱلصَّفَا وَٱلۡمَرۡوَةَ مِن شَعَآئِرِ ٱللَّهِۖ﴾ أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ ، فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا، فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَى الْبَيْتَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَوَحَّدَ اللَّهَ وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَقَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ. قَالَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ. الحديث. وفيه: ففعل على المروة كما فعل على الصفا
azkar.translationEn: Jabir said when describing the Prophet's pilgrimage: '…and when he approached mount Safa he recited: (Indeed Safa and Marwah are from the places of worship of Allah…) (I begin with what Allah began with.) so he started with Safa and climbed it until he could see the Ka'bah, he then faced it and said: (Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest.) and then he would say the following three times making a supplication (one should make a personal supplication) after each time: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant and single-handedly defeated the allies.).

azkar.text: خَيْرُ الدُّعَاءِ دُعَاءُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ، وَخَيْرُ مَا قُلْتُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّونَ مِنْ قَبْلِي: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
azkar.reward:
[ar]الترمذي (٣٥٨٥)، وحسّنه الألباني
[en]At-Tirmidhi 3585 (graded hasan by al-Albani)
[tr]Tirmizî 3585 (Elbânî: hasen)
azkar.translationEn: The best supplication is the supplication of the Day of Arafah, and the best that I and the prophets before me have said is: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is able to do all things.

azkar.text: رَكِبَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَشْعَرَ الْحَرَامَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَدَعَاهُ، وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَهَلَّلَهُ، وَوَحَّدَهُ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفًا حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدًّا، فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ
azkar.translationEn: The Prophet rode his camel, Al-Qaswa, until he reached the sacred area (Al-Mash aril Haraam). Then he faced the Qiblah and invoked Allah, and repeatedly said the words: Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great), Allahu Ahad (Allah is One) and Laa ilaaha illallaah (There is none worthy of worship but Allah). He remained stationary until the sky became yellow with the dawn, and then pressed on before sunrise.

title: التكبيرة عند رمي الجمار مع كل حصاة
